result: resolved: no core bug and no missing Base cursor site; the missing pointer is upstream behaviour (the styled component crate adds it), now covered by tests

findings.base_sites: all 17 upstream cursor lines in crates/base/src are ported (scrollbar.rs:1609; resizable/resize_handle.rs:264-300 x6; input/base/element.rs:1435,3176; input/base/state.rs:4485,4487; text/inline.rs:980,987; text/inline_flow.rs:274; text/node.rs:2219; text/inline_object.rs:334,364). The earlier 9-vs-16 count was a grep artifact
findings.button_link: upstream Base Button (button.rs:207-257) and Link (link.rs:164-208) set no cursor; the pointer comes from the styled component crate (component/src/button/button.rs:655, component/src/link.rs:90), out of scope. A Base-only app shows the arrow, as upstream does
findings.dock_splitters: dock splitter cursors are drawn by the skin (upstream examples/showcase/components/dock.rs:126-160); the Go examples lacked the strip
findings.core_path: div paint records the cursor on its hitbox (div.go:1697-1704); interact.go resolves it as window.rs:1200-1213; reset at the frame end (render.go:224, window.rs:3277) and on hit-test change (mouseevent.go:590-593, window.rs:6083-6086); App.SetCursorStyle -> Host.SetCursorStyle only while hovered (platform.rs:780-790); WM_SETCURSOR shows the stored handle (events.rs:1170-1211)
findings.cursor_gate: the three cursor-gate tests check message results and the visibility flag; the real mouse crossing their shown window resets the flag, so they stay environmental
